description: REEF3D::SEASTATE handover of 2D spectra for the phase-resolved wave generation (A 760, B 85 11 format): stationary shoaling of a Mitsuyasu spectrum (20 deg) on a plane slope with zero-gradient lateral sides, spectra at x = 3000 m and 4500 m (default sector +-90 deg) and a point outside the domain (reported, no file). Validation of the handover (SEASTATE -> FNPF) in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/11_handover.
covers: seastate_f handover, spectrum-file-2d format, sector, energy-preserving domega
